integrity: Ordinary exact rational calculations and direct permutation enumeration; no external independent audit, no claimed certification or authorship.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite connected trees of diameter <=3, n>=3. Does not determine the all-tree fixed-order optimum. Source mixed-spider formulas for one arm and near-uniform diameter-four construction are prior work; originality of the new sharp diameter-three classification remains subject to unindexed literature risk. Finite enumeration independently corroborates the analytic proof.
title: Sharp fixed-order greedy-uniformity gaps for trees of diameter at most three
